description: React component for managing and displaying session data, including server-side search, filtering, pagination, and associated charts.

methods.name: distinctSorted
methods.description: Helper function to generate a sorted list of unique, non-empty string values from an array.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts snake_case string to a human-readable label with title case.

methods.name: buildRestrictedColumns
methods.description: Builds DataTable columns based on allowed fields, with custom rendering logic for certain fields.

methods.name: loadAggregates
methods.description: Fetches multiple pages of session data to compute aggregates for charts and dropdown options.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches session data from the API with support for pagination, filtering, and sorting.
